body: Vertical 9:16 realistic fashion photograph of a fictional 30-year-old woman inside a modern mirrored elevator. She wears a black tailored jacket over an opaque high-neck ivory blouse, black ankle-length tailored trousers, and simple black flat shoes. Long straight dark brown hair. Standing naturally, she turns slightly toward the mirror and holds folded black sunglasses in one hand, looking at her own reflection. Show one coherent mirror reflection with physically plausible orientation; metal panels, elevator door and a small floor-number display establish the setting. Small subtle Keor embroidery on the jacket cuff. Neutral bright elevator lighting, realistic textile detail, relaxed confident expression, full-length editorial composition. Everyday smart clothing; no lingerie, no exposed midriff, no added captions or watermark.
